scope: Actual full inline JavaScript executed in Node VM with a minimal synthetic DOM and mocked Blob/URL/clipboard/download APIs. No browser layout, real filesystem download, browser clipboard or Godot acceptance.

checks.name: Unique IDs, two three-way comparisons and unchanged local images
Three tabs select exactly one panel
Export retains hidden-tab notes, manual state and UTF-8
Target, historical and new native PNG hashes and bounds facts match
Download fallback produces unique safe filenames and actual JSON
Import changes review controls only and preserves real evidence
Unavailable folder API retains download/text export fallback
